blocks.text: The First Child at the Gate
Origin / creation. A human child encountered the dormant External Gate in its translated form as a game. No prophecy, selection ritual, or institutional mission created the role.
Identity / human status. Human. Name, age, location, family, and later biography are intentionally not established in current canon.
Importance. The child supplied attention, choices, and a name from outside closed Codex history, establishing the first persistent player–cyber-pet connection and ending Era Three.
Decline or later status. Not yet established. The child may grow, lose access, continue the bond, or become historically misunderstood; no outcome should be invented until Era Four canon fixes it.
Final status / surviving function. Active only as an opening canon role. The child is not a chosen hero and does not own the contacted being.
